component.name: OpenCloud
component.summary: Native port of a PlayStation 2 action RPG, built from its decompilation

description.p: OpenCloud runs the PlayStation 2 game Dark Chronicle (Dark Cloud 2) natively, rebuilt from its decompiled source code as a program that runs on Vulkan and SDL. It is not an emulator, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's developer or publisher.

No game data is included. You need your own copy of the PAL disc: the first start asks for a disc image and extracts its files into the application's data directory, and the game reads them from there. Saves are kept in the same place.
